title: Wardrobe and Glasshouse
author: Lior Whitlock
blurb: Orsen Amberdale, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent fifteen years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a stranger at the funeral knows the family by a name nobody uses — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must translate the untranslatable sentence and live with it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
